text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Opposition Social Democrat leader Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa tells the paper in an interview that his party will not create political crises that could threaten Portugal's participation in the European single currency from the outset.
- Prime Minister Antonio Guterres said in a radio interview that he opposed liberalising abortion.
- China is attracting Portuguese investment. About 10 Portuguese companies, with Chinese partners, have invested at least five billion escudos in projects in China.
- President Jorge Sampaio sets off on his first official visit to Macau and China with a 104-strong delegation. He will discuss the handover of Macau to China in 1999.
- State gas company Transgas will have to spend more than 25 billion escudos if the government decides to expand the natural gas network in Portugal.
